noPrimaryKey: This table has no primary key in the result, so edits and deletes can't be saved safely. Add rows only, or use the SQL editor.
refuseView: A view has no rows of its own to change. Edit the tables underneath it.
refuseLog: Log events cannot be changed: the provider has no write path for them.
refuseDictionary: A dictionary holds a copy of what its SOURCE returns. Change the source, then reload the dictionary.
refuseReadOnly: This connection is marked read-only, so nothing here can be written. Change it on the connection.
refuseProduction: This connection is marked production, so the grid is look-only.
refuseNoKey: This table has no primary key, so there is no safe way to say which row an edit belongs to. Add one, or write the INSERT yourself in the editor.
mongoNoId: This document has no _id, so nested field edits can't be saved. Use the pipeline editor instead.
mongoNoIdColumn: This result has no _id column, so edits and deletes can't be saved safely. Add documents only, or use the pipeline editor.
pipelineEmpty: The pipeline is empty. Add at least one stage, e.g. [ { "$match": {} } ].
pipelineNotArray: A pipeline must be a JSON array of stages, e.g. [ { "$match": {} } ].
stageNotObject: Stage {stage} must be an object like { "$match": { … } }.
filterNotObject: Filter must be a JSON object, e.g. { "status": "active" }.
stageBodyInvalid: Stage {stage} ({operator}) body is not valid JSON: {message}
